title: SPE Chapter 08 - Auth: Users, Roles, Login & Remember-Me
description:
Chapter 08 of Simple PHP Engine - adding identity and authorization to the plain PHP 8.5 app.

This tutorial covers:
• Role as an ordered enum whose can() IS the access-control system
• A readonly User value object built from a database row
• Login/logout modelled as creating and destroying a session
• password_hash / password_verify and session_regenerate_id
• Per-plugin guard() checked in the front controller before the plugin runs
• Admin-only Users CRUDL (hashed passwords, no self-delete)
• Remember-me: a random selector plus a rotating, hashed validator
